item.title: Distributing Cluster Images with Dragonfly V2
item.description: 1. Introduction to Dragonfly The Dragonfly documentation at https://d7y.io/zh/docs/ already covers things in detail. Here is just a brief introduction to the main components of V2: Manager, which provides the UI, user management, cluster monitoring, task management, and other features Scheduler, which schedules traffic between Peers and provides preheating and other features Seed Peer, the back-to-source node used to download data from origin sites (Harbor, Docker.
